en.s: The Battle of Mantinea was fought on 4 July 362 BC between the Thebans, led by Epaminondas and supported by the Arcadians, Argives, Messenians, Thessalians, Euboeans and the Boeotian league against the Spartans, Eleans, Athenians, and Mantineans. The battle was to determine which of the two alliances would dominate Greece. However, the death of Epaminondas and his intended successors would cost Thebes the military leadership and initiative to maintain Theban supremacy in the region.

zh.t: 曼提尼亚战役（公元前362年）
zh.s: 公元前362年7月4日，底比斯军队在伊巴密浓达率领下，与阿卡迪亚人、阿尔戈斯人、麦西尼亚人、色萨利人、优卑亚人和波奥提亚同盟结盟，对阵斯巴达人、厄利斯人、雅典人和曼提尼亚人。此战决定两个联盟中哪一方将主导希腊。伊巴密浓达及其指定继任者阵亡后，底比斯失去维持地区霸权所需的军事领导力和主动权。

en.t: Aelia Pulcheria takes a vow of chastity and is proclaimed Augusta, thus becoming the regent of the Byzantine Empire for her 13-year-old brother Theodosius II after the death of the previous regent, praefect Anthemius
en.s: Aelia Pulcheria (; Ancient Greek: Πουλχερία; 19 January 398 or 399 – July 453) was an Eastern Roman empress who advised her brother, the emperor Theodosius II, during his minority and then became wife to emperor Marcian from November 450 to her death in 453. She was the second (and oldest surviving) child of Eastern Roman Emperor Arcadius and Empress Aelia Eudoxia.

zh.t: 埃莉娅·普尔刻里娅立下贞洁誓言并获尊为奥古斯塔，前任摄政安提米乌斯去世后，她为13岁的弟弟狄奥多西二世摄政，统治拜占庭帝国
zh.s: 埃莉娅·普尔刻里娅（古希腊语：Πουλχερία；398年或399年1月19日—453年7月）是东罗马帝国皇后。弟弟狄奥多西二世未成年期间，她辅佐其执政；450年11月至453年去世期间，她成为马尔西安皇帝的妻子。她是东罗马皇帝阿卡狄乌斯与皇后埃莉娅·欧多克西亚的第二个孩子，也是两人存活下来的长女。

en.t: Pactum Sicardi, a peace treaty between the Principality of Benevento and the Duchy of Naples, is signed
en.s: The Pactum Sicardi was a treaty signed on 4 July 836 between the Greek Duchy of Naples, including its satellite city-states of Sorrento and Amalfi, represented by Bishop John IV and Duke Andrew II, and the Lombard Prince of Benevento, Sicard. The treaty was an armistice ending a war between the Greek states and Benevento, during which the Byzantine Empire had not intervened on behalf of its subjects.

zh.s: 《西卡尔迪条约》于836年7月4日签署，是那不勒斯公国与贝内文托公国之间的一项和平条约。希腊人统治的那不勒斯公国及其附属城邦索伦托和阿马尔菲，由约翰四世主教和安德鲁二世公爵代表；伦巴第人统治的贝内文托公国则由西卡尔德亲王代表。条约是结束希腊各邦与贝内文托之间战争的停战协定，其间拜占庭帝国并未出兵援助其臣属。

en.s: The Battle of Hattin took place on 4 July 1187, between the Crusader states of the Levant and the forces of the Ayyubid Sultanate of Egypt, led by Sultan Saladin. It is also known as the Battle of the Horns of Hattin, due to the shape of the nearby extinct volcano of that name. The Muslim armies under Saladin captured or killed the vast majority of the Crusader forces, removing their capability to wage war.

zh.s: 哈丁战役于1187年7月4日爆发，交战双方是黎凡特十字军国家与埃及阿尤布苏丹国军队，后者由苏丹萨拉丁率领。附近一座同名死火山的外形，使此战也称为“哈丁之角战役”。萨拉丁麾下的穆斯林军队俘获或杀死了绝大多数十字军，摧毁了他们继续作战的能力。

en.s: The naval Battle of Cape Orlando took place on 4 July 1299 at St Marco di Val Demone, north-western Sicily, when an Aragonese and Angevin galley fleet commanded by Roger of Lauria defeated a Sicilian galley fleet commanded by Conrad d'Oria. King James II of Aragon and Frederick III of Sicily were present with their fleets at the battle. The larger Aragon-Angevin fleet was trapped on a lee shore but was able to win the battle with the intervention of its 6-galley reserve that attacked the rear of the Sicilian fleet.

zh.s: 奥兰多角海战是一场海战，于1299年7月4日在西西里岛西北部的圣马可迪瓦尔德蒙内附近发生。罗杰·迪·劳里亚指挥的阿拉贡—安茹桨帆船舰队击败了科拉多·多里亚率领的西西里舰队。阿拉贡国王海梅二世和西西里国王腓特烈三世也率舰参加了战斗。规模较大的阿拉贡—安茹舰队一度被困在背风岸边，但其预备队的6艘桨帆船袭击西西里舰队后方，帮助扭转战局。

en.s: The Siege of Belgrade, or Battle of Belgrade or Siege of Nándorfehérvár. occurred from July 4–22, 1456. After the fall of Constantinople in 1453, the Ottoman Sultan Mehmed II rallied his resources in order to subjugate the Kingdom of Hungary. His immediate objective was the border fort of the town of Belgrade (in old Hungarian Nándorfehérvár). John Hunyadi, the Voivode of Transylvania, who had fought many battles against the Turks in the previous two decades, prepared the defenses of the fortress. The siege eventually escalated into a major battle, during which Hunyadi led a sudden counterattack that overran the Ottoman camp, ultimately compelling the wounded Mehmed II to lift the siege and retreat.

zh.s: 贝尔格莱德围城战又称贝尔格莱德战役或南多尔费黑尔堡围城战，于1456年7月4日至22日发生。1453年君士坦丁堡陷落后，奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德二世集结力量，准备征服匈牙利王国，首要目标是边境要塞贝尔格莱德（旧匈牙利语称南多尔费黑尔堡）。特兰西瓦尼亚总督约翰·匈雅提此前二十多年里多次与土耳其人交战，因而着手加强要塞防御。围城后来升级为一场大战，匈雅提率军突然反击，攻入奥斯曼营地，最终迫使受伤的穆罕默德二世解除围城并撤退。

en.s: The siege of Loja was a military engagement between the Spanish Catholic Monarchs who besieged the city and the Granadan garrison of Loja. The siege ended in disaster for the Spanish, who retreated after suffering heavy losses.

en.s: The Battle of Bonefield (Hungarian: Csontmezei csata) in other sources Battle of Bone Hill (Hungarian: Csonthegyi csata) was fought between the army of John Corvinus and an army of the Kingdom of Hungary (the party of queen Beatrice of Naples) under Pál Kinizsi and Stephen V Báthory after the death of Matthias Corvinus king of Hungary, on 4 July 1490, in the Bonefield, a part of Tolna county near the extinct village Szabaton (nowadays Kölesd in Hungary.

zh.s: 骨田战役（匈牙利语：Csontmezei csata），其他资料也称骨山战役（匈牙利语：Csonthegyi csata），于1490年7月4日发生在骨田，地点位于托尔瑙县、已废弃的萨巴顿村附近（今匈牙利克勒什德）。马加什·科维努斯国王去世后，科维努斯·亚诺什的军队与匈牙利王国军队交战；后者效忠那不勒斯的贝阿特丽切王后，由帕尔·基尼日和巴托里·伊什特万五世率领。

en.s: The election of Christian III as king of Denmark on 4 July 1534 was a landmark event for all of Denmark, and also had an effect on Norway's future relation with Denmark. It took place in St. Søren's Church (Danish: Sankt Sørens Kirke) in the town of Rye in eastern Jutland, where the Jutlandic nobility elected Prince Christian, son of King Frederick I and Duke of Schleswig and Holstein, as king.

zh.s: 1534年7月4日，克里斯蒂安三世当选丹麦国王，这是丹麦历史上的重要事件，也影响了挪威此后与丹麦的关系。选举在日德兰东部吕镇的圣索伦教堂（丹麦语：Sankt Sørens Kirke）举行，日德兰贵族在会上选出王子克里斯蒂安为国王。他是国王腓特烈一世之子，也是石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因公爵。

en.s: The Battle of Klushino, or the Battle of Kłuszyn, was fought on 4 July 1610, between forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and the Tsardom of Russia during the Polish–Russian War, part of Russia's Time of Troubles. The battle occurred near the village of Klushino (Polish: Kłuszyn) near Smolensk (Polish: Smoleńsk).

zh.s: 克卢希诺战役又称克武申战役，于1610年7月4日爆发。交战双方是波兰—立陶宛联邦与俄罗斯沙皇国，战役属于俄波战争和俄罗斯混乱时期的一部分。战场位于克卢希诺村（波兰语：Kłuszyn）附近，靠近斯摩棱斯克（波兰语：Smoleńsk）。

en.s: the Action of 2 July 1618 occurred during an expedition undertaken with the purpose of apprehending pirates, Mooy Lambert encountered a fleet of Algerian corsairs on June 2. This led to a prolonged engagement lasting two days, during which Lambert displayed remarkable prowess, resulting in his victory. As a consequence of this triumph and his subsequent Expedition to Algiers (1624), Lambert gained considerable recognition and is primarily remembered for this significant battle in history.

zh.s: 1618年7月2日战斗发生于一次缉捕海盗的远征期间。6月2日，穆伊·兰伯特遇到一支阿尔及利亚海盗船队，双方随后持续交战两天，兰伯特表现出色并取得胜利。凭借这次胜利以及他后来于1624年远征阿尔及尔，兰伯特声名大振，这场战斗也成为他最为人铭记的历史事件。

en.s: The siege of Baghdad (Persian: محاصره بغداد) began as an Ottoman re-conquest attempt against the Safavids. The Safavids took Baghdad in 1624, leading to the Ottoman Grand Vizier Hafız Ahmed Pasha forming an expedition to retake Baghdad in 1625 in Ottoman Iraq. Although they breached the outer fortifications, Persian reinforcements under Shah Abbas stopped them.

zh.s: 巴格达围城战最初是奥斯曼帝国试图从萨法维王朝手中重新夺回巴格达。萨法维人于1624年攻占巴格达后，奥斯曼大维齐尔哈菲兹·艾哈迈德帕夏于1625年组织远征，试图夺回该城。奥斯曼军攻破了外层防御工事，但阿拔斯一世沙阿率领的波斯援军阻止了他们。

en.t: The city of Trois-Rivières is founded in New France (now Quebec, Canada)
en.s: Trois-Rivières (French: [tʁwɑ ʁivjɛʁ], Canadian French: [tʁwɔ ʁivjaɛ̯ʁ] ; lit. 'Three Rivers') is a city in the Mauricie administrative region of Quebec, Canada. It is located at the confluence of the Saint-Maurice and Saint Lawrence rivers, on the north shore of the Saint Lawrence River across from the city of Bécancour. It is part of the densely populated Quebec City–Windsor Corridor and is approximately halfway between Montreal and Quebec City.

zh.t: 三河城在新法兰西（今加拿大魁北克）建立
zh.s: 三河城（法语：[tʁwɑ ʁivjɛʁ]，加拿大法语：[tʁwɔ ʁivjaɛ̯ʁ]；意为“三条河”）是加拿大魁北克省莫里斯行政区的一座城市，位于圣莫里斯河与圣劳伦斯河交汇处，在圣劳伦斯河北岸，与贝坎库尔隔河相望。该市属于人口稠密的魁北克市—温莎走廊，大约位于蒙特利尔与魁北克市之间的中点。

en.s: The siege of Leuven (24 June – 4 July 1635) was an important siege in the Thirty Years' War in which a Franco-Dutch army under Frederick Henry of Orange and the French Marshals Urbain de Maillé-Brezé and Gaspard III de Coligny, who had invaded the Spanish Netherlands from two sides, laid siege to the city of Leuven, defended by a force of 4,000 comprising local citizen and student militias with Walloons, Germans, Spanish and Irish of the Army of Flanders under Anthonie Schetz, Baron of Grobbendonck.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 鲁汶围城战发生于1635年6月24日至7月4日，是三十年战争期间的一场重要围城战。奥兰治亲王弗雷德里克·亨德里克与法国元帅乌尔班·德·马耶-布雷泽、加斯帕尔三世·德·科利尼率领法荷联军，从两个方向入侵西属尼德兰并围攻鲁汶。守军共4,000人，包括当地居民、学生民兵，以及佛兰德军团内的瓦隆人、德国人、西班牙人和爱尔兰人，由格罗本东克男爵安东尼·谢茨指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Burton Bridge was fought between Royalist and Parliamentarian forces at Burton upon Trent on 4 July 1643 during the First English Civil War. By the time of the battle the town, which had at various times been held by both sides, was garrisoned by a Parliamentarian unit under the command of Captain Thomas Sanders and the town's military governor, Colonel Richard Houghton. The key river crossing at Burton was desired by Queen Henrietta Maria, who was proceeding southwards from Yorkshire with a convoy of supplies destined for King Charles I at Oxford.

zh.s: 1643年7月4日，保王党军和议会军在特伦特河畔伯顿交战，当时正值第一次英国内战。战役发生时，该镇曾先后被双方控制，目前由托马斯·桑德斯上尉率领的一支议会军守卫，镇上的军事总督是理查德·霍顿上校。亨丽埃塔·玛丽亚王后希望控制伯顿的关键河道渡口，她当时正从约克郡南下，护送一支运往牛津、供查理一世使用的补给车队。

zh.s: 用户：RMCD 机器人／主题通知。《独立宣言》是第二届大陆会议于1776年7月4日在费城宾夕法尼亚州议会大厦（独立厅）通过的声明。声明宣布，当时正与大不列颠王国交战的十三个美洲殖民地将自己视为十三个新近独立的主权国家，不再受英国统治。

en.s: The capture of Grenada was an amphibious expedition in July 1779 during the American Revolutionary War. A French fleet under Admiral Charles Henri Hector, Count of Estaing captured the island of Grenada from the British. The French landed on 2 July and the assault occurred on the night of 3–4 July. The French forces assaulted the British fortifications on Hospital Hill, overlooking the island's capital, Saint George's.

zh.s: 法军攻占格林纳达是美国独立战争期间于1779年7月发动的一次两栖远征。夏尔·亨利·埃克托尔·德斯坦伯爵海军上将率领法国舰队，从英国手中夺取格林纳达岛。法军于7月2日登陆，并在7月3日至4日夜间发起进攻，袭击俯瞰该岛首府圣乔治的医院山英军防御工事。

en.t: The United States Military Academy opens at West Point, New York
en.s: The United States Military Academy (USMA), commonly known as West Point, is a United States service academy in West Point, New York, that educates cadets for service as commissioned officers in the United States Army. The academy was founded in 1802, and it is the oldest of the five American service academies.

zh.t: 美国军事学院在纽约西点开放
zh.s: 美国军事学院（USMA），通常称为西点军校，位于纽约州西点，培养美国陆军军官。学院于1802年创立，是美国五所军种学院中历史最悠久的一所。

en.s: The Battle of Maida on 4 July 1806 was a battle between the British expeditionary force and a First French Empire division outside the town of Maida in Calabria, Italy during the Napoleonic Wars. John Stuart led 5,200 British troops to victory over about 6,000 French soldiers under Jean Reynier, inflicting significant losses while incurring relatively few casualties. Maida is located in the toe of Italy, about 30 kilometres (19 mi) west of Catanzaro. In early 1806, the French invaded and overran the Kingdom of Naples, forcing King Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies and his government to flee to Sicily.

zh.s: 迈达战役于1806年7月4日在意大利卡拉布里亚迈达镇外发生，是拿破仑战争期间英军远征部队与法兰西第一帝国一个师之间的战斗。约翰·斯图亚特率领5,200名英军，击败让·雷尼耶指挥的约6,000名法军；英军造成敌方重大损失，自身伤亡则相对较少。迈达位于意大利“靴尖”地区，卡坦扎罗以西约30公里（19英里）。1806年初，法军入侵并占领那不勒斯王国，迫使两西西里国王斐迪南一世及其政府逃往西西里岛。

en.s: The Battle of Zitlala took place during the War of Mexican Independence on 4 July 1812 in the outskirts of Zitlala, Guerrero. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The battle resulted in a victory for the Mexican rebels.

zh.s: 齐特拉拉战役于1812年7月4日在墨西哥独立战争期间发生，地点在格雷罗州齐特拉拉郊外。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室的保皇派军队，以及争取脱离西班牙帝国独立的墨西哥起义军。战斗以墨西哥起义军获胜告终。

en.s: The Flag Acts are three laws that sought to define the design of the flag of the United States. All the submitted suggestions were remarkably short, the shortest being a sentence of 31 words, and the longest being a title and two sentences of 117 words. The brevity of the Acts leave a lot of ambiguity since neither the size or shape of the flag nor the exact colors or the size or placement of the design elements is specified.

zh.s: 国旗法案是三项旨在规定美国国旗设计的法律。所有提交的提案都非常简短，最短的只有31个词，最长的也只有一个标题和两句话，共117个词。法案文字过于简略，留下许多模糊之处：它们没有规定国旗的大小或形状，也没有明确图案元素的具体颜色、尺寸或位置。

en.t: Durham University established by Act of Parliament; the first recognized university to be founded in England since Cambridge over 600 years earlier
en.s: The University of Durham, which operates under the trading name of Durham University, is a collegiate public research university in Durham, England, founded by an Act of Parliament in 1832 and incorporated by royal charter in 1837. It was the first recognised university to open in England for more than 600 years, after Oxford and Cambridge, and is thus identified by historians as the third-oldest university in England.

zh.t: 达勒姆大学依据议会法案创立
zh.s: 达勒姆大学于1832年依据议会法案创立，1837年获皇家特许状注册。它是牛津和剑桥之后英格兰最早获认可建立的大学，因此历史学家将其列为英格兰第三古老的大学。

en.t: 1836–37 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1836–37 United States House of Representatives elections were held on various dates in various states between July 4, 1836, and November 7, 1837. Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives, either before or after the first session of the 25th United States Congress convened on September 4, 1837.

en.t: The Grand Junction Railway, the world's first long-distance railway with steam traction, opened between Birmingham and Newton Junction
en.s: The Grand Junction Railway (GJR) was an early railway company in the United Kingdom, which existed between 1833 and 1846. The line built by the company, which opened in 1837, linked the Liverpool and Manchester Railway to Birmingham via Warrington, Crewe, Stafford and Wolverhampton. This was the first trunk railway to be completed in England, and arguably the world's first long-distance railway with steam traction.

zh.t: 大章克申铁路开通，成为世界首条蒸汽牵引长途铁路
zh.s: 大章克申铁路公司（GJR）是英国早期的一家铁路公司，存续于1833年至1846年。公司修建的铁路线于1837年开通，经沃灵顿、克鲁、斯塔福德和伍尔弗汉普顿，将利物浦—曼彻斯特铁路与伯明翰连接起来。这是英格兰建成的第一条干线铁路，也常被认为是世界上第一条采用蒸汽牵引的长途铁路。

en.s: The 1838 Louisiana gubernatorial election was the eighth gubernatorial election to take place after Louisiana achieved statehood. Under Article III Sec 2 of the 1812 Constitution of the State of Louisiana the Governor was elected in two steps. On the first Monday in July, eligible voters went to the polls and voted. The returns were sent to the President of the Louisiana State Senate.

zh.s: 1838年路易斯安那州州长选举是路易斯安那成为美国一州后举行的第八次州长选举。根据1812年《路易斯安那州宪法》第三条第二款，州长通过两阶段程序选出。7月的第一个星期一，符合资格的选民前往投票站投票，选举结果送交路易斯安那州参议院议长。

en.t: The first edition of Walt Whitman's book of poems, Leaves of Grass, is published in Brooklyn
en.s: Leaves of Grass is a poetry collection by American poet Walt Whitman. After self-publishing it in 1855, he spent most of his professional life writing, revising, and expanding the collection until his death in 1892. Either six or nine separate editions of the book were produced, depending on how one defines a new edition. The continual modifications to Leaves of Grass resulted in vastly different copies of it circulating in Whitman's lifetime.

zh.t: 《草叶集》首版在布鲁克林出版
zh.s: 美国诗人沃尔特·惠特曼于1855年自费出版《草叶集》。此后直至1892年去世，他的大部分职业生涯都在创作、修订和扩充这部诗集。由于对“新版”的定义不同，该书先后出版过6版或9版。惠特曼生前不断修改《草叶集》，因此各版内容差异很大。

en.s: The Battle of Tebbs' Bend (or Tebbs Bend or Green River) was fought on July 4, 1863, near the Green River in Taylor County, Kentucky during Morgan's Raid in the American Civil War. Despite being badly outnumbered, elements of the Union army thwarted repeated attacks by Confederate Brig. Gen. John Hunt Morgan's dismounted cavalry.

zh.s: 特布斯湾战役又称特布斯湾或格林河战役，于1863年7月4日在美国内战摩根突袭期间，发生于肯塔基州泰勒县格林河附近。尽管人数远少于敌军，联邦军仍击退了约翰·亨特·摩根准将率领的南方邦联骑兵多次进攻。

en.s: The Battle of Helena was a land battle of the American Civil War fought on July 4, 1863, at Helena, Arkansas. The battle was a Confederate attempt to relieve pressure on the besieged city of Vicksburg. The victory secured eastern Arkansas for the United States.

zh.s: 海伦娜战役是美国内战期间的一场陆战，于1863年7月4日在阿肯色州海伦娜发生。南方邦联试图通过此战减轻遭围困的维克斯堡所受压力。联邦军获胜，确保美国控制阿肯色州东部。

en.s: The siege of Vicksburg (May 18 – July 4, 1863) was the final major military action in the Vicksburg campaign of the American Civil War. In a series of maneuvers, Union major general Ulysses S. Grant and his Army of the Tennessee crossed the Mississippi River and drove the Confederate Army of Mississippi, led by Lieutenant General John C.
en.n: American Civil War: Siege of Vicksburg: The Confederate army in Vicksburg, Mississippi surrenders to Union forces under Ulysses S. Grant after 47 days of siege, contributing to the Union capture of the Mississippi River.

zh.s: 维克斯堡围城战（1863年5月18日至7月4日）是美国内战维克斯堡战役中最后一场大型军事行动。在一系列机动行动中，联邦军少将尤利西斯·S·格兰特及其田纳西军团渡过密西西比河，击退由中将约翰·C……率领的密西西比邦联军。
zh.n: 美国内战：维克斯堡围城战中，密西西比州维克斯堡的邦联军在被围困47天后向尤利西斯·S·格兰特率领的联邦军投降，促成联邦军控制密西西比河。

Lee's failure to defeat the Union Army at the Battle of Gettysburg (July 1–3, 1863), he ordered a retreat through Maryland and over the Potomac River to relative safety in Virginia. The Union Army of the Potomac, commanded by Maj. Gen. George G.

en.s: The Battle of Dermbach was the first clash between Prussian and Bavarian troops in the Austro-Prussian War near Dermbach, Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach in modern-day Thuringia on 4 July 1866. On the Prussian side, the 13th Division under Lieutenant General von Goeben was deployed which faced parts of the 3rd and 4th Bavarian infantry divisions with a total strength of approx. 15,000 men. The Commander-in-Chief on the Bavarian side was Prince Karl.

zh.s: 德恩巴赫战役是普鲁士与巴伐利亚军队在普奥战争中的首次交战，于1866年7月4日在萨克森-魏玛-艾森纳赫的德恩巴赫附近发生，该地今属图林根州。普鲁士第13师由冯·戈本中将率领，与巴伐利亚第3和第4步兵师的部分部队交战，巴军兵力约15,000人。巴伐利亚方面的总司令是卡尔亲王。

en.s: The Battle of Ueno (Japanese: 上野戦争, Hepburn: Ueno Sensō) was a battle of the Boshin War, which occurred on 4 July 1868 (Meiji 1, 15th day of the 5th month), between the troops of the Shōgitai under Shibusawa Seiichirō and Amano Hachirō, and Imperial "Kangun" troops.

zh.s: 上野战争（日语：上野戦争，罗马字：Ueno Sensō）是戊辰战争期间的一场战斗，于1868年7月4日（明治元年五月十五日）爆发。交战双方是由涩泽成一郎和天野八郎率领的彰义队，以及明治新政府的“官军”。

en.s: The Battle of Ulundi took place at the Zulu capital of Ulundi on 4 July 1879 and was the last major battle of the Anglo-Zulu War. The British army broke the military power of the Zulu nation by defeating the main Zulu army and immediately afterwards capturing and razing the capital of Zululand, the royal kraal of Ulundi.

zh.s: 乌伦迪战役于1879年7月4日在祖鲁王国首都乌伦迪发生，是英祖战争的最后一场重大战役。英军击败祖鲁主力，摧毁祖鲁王国的军事力量，随后立即攻占并夷平乌伦迪王室围场所在的祖鲁首都。

en.s: The Anglo-Zulu War, or simply the Zulu War, was fought in present-day South Africa from January to early July 1879 between forces of the British Empire and the Zulu Kingdom. Two famous battles of the war were the Zulu victory at Isandlwana and the British defence at Rorke's Drift.

en.t: In Alabama, the Tuskegee Institute opens
en.s: Tuskegee University (Tuskegee or TU; formerly known as the Tuskegee Institute) is a private, historically black land-grant university in Tuskegee, Alabama, United States. It was founded as a normal school for black teachers on July 4, 1881, by the Alabama Legislature. Tuskegee University offers 43 bachelor's degree programs, including a five-year accredited professional degree program in architecture, 17 master's degree programs, and 5 doctoral degree programs, including the Doctor of Veterinary Medicine.

zh.t: 阿拉巴马州塔斯基吉学院开学
zh.s: 塔斯基吉大学（Tuskegee或TU，曾名塔斯基吉学院）是位于美国阿拉巴马州塔斯基吉的一所私立大学，也是历史上主要面向黑人学生的赠地大学。1881年7月4日，阿拉巴马州议会创办该校，最初是一所培养黑人教师的师范学校。塔斯基吉大学开设43个学士学位项目，包括一个经认证的五年制建筑专业学位项目；17个硕士学位项目；以及5个博士学位项目，其中包括兽医学博士。

en.s: The Second Franco-Dahomean War, which raged from 1892 to 1894, was a major conflict between France, led by General Alfred-Amédée Dodds, and Dahomey under King Béhanzin. The French emerged triumphant and incorporated Dahomey into their growing colonial territory of French West Africa.

en.t: Sinking of the SS La Bourgogne
en.s: On 4 July 1898, the SS La Bourgogne collided with the sailing ship Cromartyshire while the two ships were in thick fog off Newfoundland, and Cromartyshire had reduced speed, but La Bourgogne was steaming at high speed. The La Bourgogne sank forty minutes after the collision, killing 562 of the 725 people aboard. It was, at the time, one of the worst maritime disasters in history.

zh.s: 1898年7月4日，客轮“拉布尔戈涅号”在纽芬兰附近的浓雾中与帆船“克罗马蒂郡号”相撞。当时“克罗马蒂郡号”已减速，但“拉布尔戈涅号”仍在高速航行。相撞40分钟后，“拉布尔戈涅号”沉没，船上725人中有562人遇难。当时，这被视为历史上最严重的海难之一。

en.s: The Johnson–Jeffries riots were a series of race riots that occurred throughout the United States after African-American boxer Jack Johnson defeated white boxer James J. Jeffries in a boxing match termed the "Fight of the Century". Johnson became the first black World Heavyweight champion in 1908. This success made him unpopular with the predominantly white American boxing audiences. Jeffries, a former heavyweight champion, came out of retirement to fight Johnson and was nicknamed the "Great White Hope". After Johnson defeated Jeffries on July 4, 1910, many white people became enraged and began attacking black people who were celebrating Johnson's victory.

zh.s: 约翰逊—杰弗里斯骚乱是杰克·约翰逊在一场被称为“世纪之战”的拳击赛中击败白人拳手詹姆斯·J·杰弗里斯后，美国各地发生的一系列种族骚乱。约翰逊于1908年成为首位黑人世界重量级拳击冠军。他的成就使他不受以白人为主的美国拳击观众欢迎。曾任重量级拳王的杰弗里斯复出挑战约翰逊，并被称为“伟大的白人希望”。1910年7月4日约翰逊获胜后，许多白人愤怒不已，开始袭击庆祝约翰逊获胜的黑人。

en.s: The Bandit War, or Bandit Wars, was a series of raids in Texas that started in 1915 and finally culminated in 1919. They were carried out by Mexican rebels from the states of Tamaulipas, Coahuila, and Chihuahua. Prior to 1914, the Carrancistas had been responsible for most attacks along the border, but in January 1915, rebels known as "Sedicionistas" drafted the Plan of San Diego and began launching their own raids.

The Battle of Mecca was part of the Arab Revolt of World War I.

en.s: The Battle of Hamel was an attack by Australian Army and US Army infantry, supported by Tank Corps tanks, against German positions in and around the town of Le Hamel, in northern France, during World War I. en.s: The 1919 Peruvian coup d'état took place on July 4, 1919, headed by former president and president-elect Augusto B. Leguía, with the support of the gendarmerie forces of Lima, against the outgoing government of José Pardo y Barreda. The result of the coup was successful for Leguía, who began the political process known as the New Motherland, through which he sought to modernise the country through a change in relations between the state and civil society, and which led to an eleven-year dictatorship.

zh.s: 1919年7月4日，前总统、当选总统奥古斯托·B·莱吉亚在利马宪兵部队支持下发动政变，推翻即将卸任的何塞·帕尔多·伊·巴雷达政府。政变成功后，莱吉亚开启了被称为“新祖国”的政治进程，试图通过改变国家与公民社会的关系推动国家现代化，最终导致长达11年的独裁统治。

en.s: The Telangana Rebellion of 1946–1951 was a communist-led insurrection of peasants against the princely state of Hyderabad in the region of Telangana that escalated out of agitations in 1944–1946. Hyderabad was a feudal monarchy where most of the land was concentrated in the hands of landed aristocrats known as "Durras" or "Doras" in Telangana. Feudal exploitation in the region was more severe compared to others of India; the Durras had complete power over the peasants and could subject them to agricultural slavery. Conditions worsened during the 1930s due to the Great Depression and a transition towards commercial crops. In the 1940s, the peasants started turning towards communism, organised themselves through the Andhra Mahasabha and began a rights movement. Catalysed by a food crisis that affected the region following the end of the Second World War, the movement escalated into a rebellion after the administration and the durras attempted to suppress it. The revolt began on 4 July 1946, when a local peasant leader was killed in the village of Kadavendi, Warangal, by the agents of a dorra.

zh.s: 1946至1951年的特伦甘纳叛乱是一场由共产党领导的农民起义，反抗海得拉巴土邦政权。起义源于1944至1946年的一系列抗议活动。海得拉巴是封建君主制国家，大部分土地掌握在特伦甘纳地区被称为“杜拉”或“多拉”的地主贵族手中。当地封建剥削比印度其他地区严重，地主对农民拥有完全支配权，能强迫他们从事农业奴役。大萧条和经济作物转型使情况在20世纪30年代进一步恶化。20世纪40年代，农民开始转向共产主义，通过安得拉大会组织起来，争取自身权利。第二次世界大战结束后，当地粮食危机加剧；行政当局和地主试图镇压运动，最终使其升级为叛乱。1946年7月4日，卡达文迪村一名农民领袖遭地主代理人杀害，叛乱由此爆发。

en.s: The Liverpool Walton by-election was held on 4 July 1991, following the death of the Labour Party Member of Parliament Eric Heffer for Liverpool Walton, on 27 May. The constituency had become a safe Labour seat under Heffer, who was known as being on the left of the party and a member of the Campaign Group. The Trotskyist Militant group, using entryist tactics was working within the Labour Party, and had gained control of Liverpool City Council in 1982. The city had become a significant base for the group. When Heffer announced his retirement, Lesley Mahmood, a "Broad Left" councillor and a member of Militant, stood for the Labour nomination.

zh.s: 利物浦沃尔顿选区补选于1991年7月4日举行，起因是该选区工党议员埃里克·赫弗于5月27日去世。赫弗任内，该选区已成为工党的稳固席位；他是党内左翼人物，也是 Campaign Group 成员。托洛茨基主义组织“激进派”通过打入工党的策略在党内活动，并于1982年控制了利物浦市议会，使该市成为该组织的重要据点。赫弗宣布退休后，工党左翼市议员、“激进派”成员莱斯利·马哈茂德竞逐工党提名。

en.s: Vladivostok Air Flight 352 was a scheduled passenger flight from Yekaterinburg, Russia to Vladivostok via Irkutsk. On 4 July 2001, the aircraft operating the flight, a Tupolev Tu-154M with tail number RA-85845, lost control, stalled, and crashed while approaching Irkutsk Airport. All 136 passengers and 9 flight crew members aboard perished, making it the third deadliest aircraft crash over Russian territory to date after Aeroflot Flight 3352 and Aeroflot Flight 217.

zh.t: 符拉迪沃斯托克航空352号班机空难
zh.s: 符拉迪沃斯托克航空352号班机是俄罗斯叶卡捷琳堡经伊尔库茨克飞往符拉迪沃斯托克的定期客运航班。2001年7月4日，执行该航班的图-154M客机（尾号RA-85845）在接近伊尔库茨克机场时失控、失速并坠毁。机上136名乘客和9名机组人员全部遇难。按俄罗斯境内的航空事故计算，这是死亡人数第三多的空难，仅次于俄航3352号和217号班机空难。

en.s: On 4 July 2002 a Boeing 707-123B operated by Prestige Airlines and owned by New Gomair, crashed during an emergency landing at Bangui Airport. 28 people on board were killed and two survived. The flight was bound to Brazzaville, but the crew decided to divert to Bangui when the landing gear had not retracted. As of May 2014, the crash remains the second deadliest aviation accident in the Central African Republic.

zh.s: 2002年7月4日，一架由Prestige Airlines运营、归New Gomair所有的波音707-123B客机在班吉机场紧急迫降时坠毁。机上28人死亡，2人生还。航班原定飞往布拉柴维尔，但因起落架无法收起，机组决定改降班吉。截至2014年5月，这仍是中非共和国第二严重的航空事故。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Kiribati on 4 July 2003, the second in six months after previous president Teburoro Tito was removed from office by a motion of no confidence in the Parliament just a month after winning the February elections, and just a day into his new term. The Kiribati Court of Appeal ruled that the single day in office constituted a third term, barring him from standing in further elections in accordance with the constitution.

zh.s: 基里巴斯于2003年7月4日举行总统选举，这是六个月内举行的第二次总统选举。前总统特布罗罗·蒂托于2月大选获胜，但仅一个月后就遭议会不信任动议罢免，并在新任期开始仅一天后下台。基里巴斯上诉法院裁定，这一天的任期也算作第三个总统任期，因此根据宪法，蒂托不得再参加选举。

en.s: The UEFA Euro 2004 Final was a football match played on 4 July 2004 at the Estádio da Luz in Lisbon, Portugal to determine the winner of UEFA Euro 2004. The match featured tournament hosts Portugal, who went into the match as favourites, and Greece, playing in only their second European Championship. It was the first time in a major international tournament where both finalists had also played in the opening game of the tournament. Both teams had qualified for the knockout stage from Group A of the tournament's group stage, with Greece winning 2–1 in the teams' earlier meeting.

zh.s: 2004年欧洲杯决赛是决定该届赛事冠军的一场足球比赛，于2004年7月4日在葡萄牙里斯本的光明球场举行。对阵双方是赛事东道主、赛前被看好的葡萄牙队，以及第二次参加欧洲杯的希腊队。这是大型国际赛事历史上首次出现决赛双方此前也在该届赛事揭幕战中交手的情况。两队都从小组赛A组晋级淘汰赛；此前交手时希腊以2比1获胜。

en.s: The Beijing–Tianjin intercity railway (simplified Chinese: 京津城际铁路; traditional Chinese: 京津城際鐵路; pinyin: Jīng-Jīn chéngjì tiělù) is a Chinese high-speed railway that runs 117 kilometres (72.7 mi) line between Beijing and Tianjin. en.s: The Tuareg rebellion of 2006 was a short-lived rebellion by Tuareg notables demanding more autonomy for Kidal Region between May 23 and July 4, 2006. The rebellion began with mutinies by Tuareg officers integrated into the Malian army following the Tuareg rebellion of the 1990s, and mediation between the Malian government and the May 23, 2006 Democratic Alliance for Change (ADC) began immediately afterwards.

zh.s: 2006年图阿雷格人叛乱是一次短暂的武装叛乱，图阿雷格人领袖要求基达尔区获得更多自治权，叛乱发生于2006年5月23日至7月4日。此前，图阿雷格人曾于20世纪90年代发动叛乱；这次叛乱始于加入马里军队的图阿雷格军官哗变。随后，马里政府与2006年5月23日民主变革联盟（ADC）立即开始调停。

en.s: STS-121 was a 2006 Space Shuttle mission to the International Space Station (ISS) flown by Space Shuttle Discovery on its 32nd flight. The main purposes of the mission were to test new safety and repair techniques introduced following the Columbia disaster of February 2003 as well as to deliver supplies, equipment, and European Space Agency (ESA) astronaut Thomas Reiter to the ISS. The European segment of the mission was called "Astrolab". After two weather-related delays, the shuttle successfully launched on Tuesday, July 4, 2006, at 14:37:55 EDT.

zh.s: STS-121是2006年一次飞往国际空间站（ISS）的航天飞机任务，由“发现号”航天飞机执行，这是该航天飞机的第32次飞行。任务主要目的是测试哥伦比亚号灾难（2003年2月）后引入的新安全措施和维修技术，并向国际空间站运送补给、设备和欧洲航天局（ESA）宇航员托马斯·赖特。任务的欧洲部分称为“阿斯特罗实验室”。经历两次因天气原因推迟后，航天飞机于2006年7月4日（星期二）美国东部夏令时间14时37分55秒成功发射。

en.s: The 2008 Minsk bombing took place just after midnight on 4 July 2008, in Minsk, Belarus and wounded 54 people. The explosion happened near the Hero City Memorial at a concert to celebrate Belarus' independence. The concert had been attended by Belarus' President, Alexander Lukashenko, who was not hurt and who officials said was not the target. A second, larger bomb was discovered before the blast. No clear motive for the blast has been revealed. However, Belarusian authorities detained four members of the White Legion, a nationalist group, in the days following the attack.

zh.s: 2008年7月4日刚过午夜，白俄罗斯明斯克发生爆炸，造成54人受伤。爆炸发生在一场庆祝白俄罗斯独立的音乐会上，地点靠近“英雄城市”纪念碑。白俄罗斯总统亚历山大·卢卡申科也出席了音乐会，未受伤；官员称他不是袭击目标。爆炸发生前还发现了第二枚威力更大的炸弹。袭击动机至今没有明确结论。事发后数日内，白俄罗斯当局拘留了民族主义团体“白色军团”的四名成员。

en.t: The discovery of particles consistent with the Higgs boson at the Large Hadron Collider is announced at CERN
en.s: The Higgs boson, sometimes called the Higgs particle, is an elementary particle in the Standard Model of particle physics produced by the quantum excitation of the Higgs field, one of the fields in particle physics theory. In the Standard Model, the Higgs particle is a massive scalar boson that couples to (interacts with) particles whose mass arises from their interactions with the Higgs field, has zero spin, even (positive) parity, no electric charge, and no color charge.

zh.s: 希格斯玻色子有时也称希格斯粒子，是粒子物理学标准模型中的一种基本粒子，由希格斯场的量子激发产生；希格斯场是粒子物理理论中的场之一。在标准模型中，希格斯粒子是有质量的标量玻色子，会与质量源于希格斯场相互作用的粒子耦合（发生相互作用）；它的自旋为零，宇称为正，无电荷，也无色荷。

en.s: The Gibraltar by-election, 2013 was a parliamentary by-election held on 4 July 2013 for the Gibraltar Parliament. The by-election was to contest the seat left vacant by the death of Government of Gibraltar Housing Minister Charles Bruzon in April 2013. The Gibraltar Socialist Labour Party (GSLP), Gibraltar Social Democrats (GSD), Progressive Democratic Party (PDP) and an independent contested the by-election. The Liberal Party of Gibraltar who is in alliance and in Government with the GSLP backed the GSLP's candidate. The Gibraltar Broadcasting Corporation's pre-election poll gave the GSLP's candidate Albert Isola an advantage of almost 5% over the GSD's Marlene Hassan Nahon.
